summary.en: OLS, the normal equation, coefficients, R², multiple regression

files.name: main.py
files.code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score, mean_squared_error

df = pd.read_csv("housing.csv")           # area_m2, rooms, age_years, distance_km, price
X = df[["area_m2"]]
y = df["price"]

model = LinearRegression().fit(X, y)
print(model.coef_, model.intercept_)       # độ dốc và hệ số chặn
print("R2:", round(model.score(X, y), 3))

# Nhiều đặc trưng
X4 = df[["area_m2", "rooms", "age_years", "distance_km"]]
m4 = LinearRegression().fit(X4, y)
print(dict(zip(X4.columns, m4.coef_.round(1))))
print("R2:", round(r2_score(y, m4.predict(X4)), 3))

solution.code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("housing.csv")
X = df[["area_m2", "rooms", "age_years", "distance_km"]].to_numpy()
y = df["price"].to_numpy()
Xb = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)), X])
theta = np.linalg.solve(Xb.T @ Xb, Xb.T @ y)
print(theta.round(2))
